# Adi Putra Waruwu

> Web developer based in Medan, Sumatera Utara, Indonesia. Builds websites and web applications (company profiles, landing pages, online stores, custom systems such as pharmacy POS) with Next.js, React and Laravel. Serves Medan, Nias, Sumatera and all of Indonesia. Contact: WhatsApp +62 838-3609-8858.

## Main pages

- [Home / portfolio](https://adi-putra-waruwu.vercel.app/): about, projects, services, contact
- [Jasa pembuatan website Medan](https://adi-putra-waruwu.vercel.app/jasa-pembuatan-website-medan): services, process, service area, FAQ
- [Blog](https://adi-putra-waruwu.vercel.app/blog): project stories
